blocking_issue: JAX compiled against NumPy 2.0 C-API but installed NumPy is 1.26.4 (C-API 0x11). Binary incompatibility cannot be fixed without upgrading NumPy to 2.x (which breaks pandas 2.1.4).
how_to_fix: Create a SEPARATE virtual environment with: torch>=2.1,<2.5 (CPU) + numpy>=2.0 + scipy~=1.11.3 + einops==0.7.* + jax + jaxtyping + hydra + uni2ts. Run Moirai inference in this separate env, save results to the shared project directory.
minimum_requirements: Separate venv (~2GB disk) with compatible versions for all uni2ts dependencies
